scope: Durable indexing, retrieval, grounded answers and task monitoring; not the whole M3 learning agent
collection: Recorded from individually executed commands and inspected runtime evidence
environment: Windows, Python 3.13.9, Node 22.19.0, Taro 4.1.11, isolated loopback MySQL 8.0.45 and Chroma

checks.includes: Actual worker child-process termination and restart, duplicate result rejection, cancellation and timeout cleanup grace

checks.command: python -m ruff check backend/app backend/integration --select F

limitations: Native WeChat execution and real devices not verified
No production deployment or shared gateway mutation
Legacy quiz/report/search/image work still needs durable budget integration
Broader lint/style rules and CI setup remain pending
